name: Maryen
source:
Maryen is the kind-hearted guardian of the Heaven kingdom and is beloved by most of the citizens there.
Unlike her sister [url=/c100172]Kendra[/url], she doesn´t have a bad bone in her and believes in karma. She is gentle and merciful and always lends her hand to help.
translation:
Maryen is the kind-hearted guardian of the Heaven kingdom and is beloved by most of the citizens there.
Unlike her sister [url=/c100172]Kendra[/url], she doesn´t have a bad bone in her and believes in karma. She is gentle and merciful and always lends her hand to help.
